narrative_engine.thesis: trend up context (H4 stack up · D1 stack up · EMA spread 3.92 ATR · price holds above Day VWAP) set the LONG bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.2976-0.3156 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.2862; the first objective pays 2.33R at 0.3252.

plan.triggerRule: footprint sdiv fired buy in long direction at the zone
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.2862 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 A/A+ demoted: no positive-delta absorption or CVD divergence at the pullback zone
